
A reference is a document ref plus an optional fragment: `#sec-<anchor>` names a position in the document, and `#rule-<n>` names the rule numbered `n` as arranged in that document. Header references, edge targets and in-document links resolve a `#sec-` fragment against the target's current version when they are written, to the rule or spec heading at that anchor (WL-REQ-165), and survive heading rewording. A `#rule-<n>` fragment needs no resolution and survives any change to the document's arrangement, so it is the form to write. A `#sec-` fragment naming an anchor absent from the target, and a `#rule-<n>` fragment naming a rule the target does not arrange, are broken references and fail `lode doc lint`.
